receivers.engine_label: MEASURED log, MODELLED assessment: the observables are the receiver's own; the monitors and their thresholds are the engine's and the scenario's, and a stated prediction is compared with the log, not fitted to it

area.note: MODELLED: the extent of the observers (receivers, vessels, aircraft) that showed an effect, at their last clean position, plus a margin. It is not an emitter location. The real affected area may be larger (where nobody observed) or smaller (the margin), and unaffected observers inside the box weigh against a single wide-area source.

checklist.item: Every input file is hashed (SHA-256) in the report
Every receiver log states absolute time (UTC), so it can be placed in the window
Every input covers at least 90 % of the incident window
Each receiver's baseline (calibration window) ends before the incident window opens
A chain-of-custody record for every input (who sent it, when, how)
Hashes stated by the senders match the files received
At least two independent sources with data in the window
checklist.detail: 1 source(s) with data in the window

checklist.item: Every attributed finding is corroborated by an independent source (high confidence)
checklist.detail: indicative only (not corroborated): F1; the report states them, claim-grade does not rest on them

checklist.item: An open-engine evidence pack for every receiver log, inside the signed bundle
Expert review completed and signed by a named reviewer
checklist.detail: not required for the standard pack

expert_review.how_to_complete: The reviewer runs `kshana-pro forensics review <bundle> --reviewer <name> --qualification <text> --organisation <text> --independence <text> --decision <concur|concur-with-reservations|do-not-concur> --statement-file <file> --key-file <reviewer key>`; the issuer then re-signs the bundle.

limits: The method's pre-registered detection bars on a labelled set (roadmap V2: public events plus synthetic) are not yet met. The method has been exercised on the open engine's synthetic training scenarios only; no detection rate, false-alarm rate or accuracy is claimed for real incidents.
Findings rest only on the files listed under Inputs. Data that was not supplied (other receivers, radar, VHF, the crew's observations) may change them.
Receiver-log times are as the receiver stated them; a spoofed receiver can state a false time, which the time-consistency monitor tests only against the log's own sequence.

AIS and ADS-B positions are broadcasts by the vessels and aircraft themselves (REPORTED): under spoofing they show the false position, and their absence can have causes other than interference (coverage, equipment, switch-off).
The affected area is the extent of the observers that showed an effect. No emitter location is estimated here.
Confidence levels follow the stated points rule; they are not probabilities.
